instruction: Linux Thunderbird has an email titled `Tasks for today` with a task-list CSV attachment. In the Android Tasks app, add one incomplete task using the `title` from every CSV row.
setup_note: Linux Thunderbird Inbox 注入带 CSV 附件的邮件；Android 清空 Tasks app。
evaluate_note: Requires the exact multiset of eight incomplete attachment titles, with no duplicates or extras in isolated benchmark-owned Tasks state.
fixture_notes: Thunderbird Local Folders Inbox is seeded as a valid mbox message with a From_ envelope and the MIME tasks.csv attachment; Inbox.msf is removed for rebuild.
The single scored task-set evaluator checks title multiplicity, incomplete state, and absence of extras.
The CSV is available only through the Thunderbird attachment during the task.
AndroidWorld provides an isolated full Tasks database reset, which setup and cleanup use as benchmark-owned state.
